# DSH Plugin Discovery & Ranking

Use when the user wants to find, compare, or rank DSH community plugins by
topic, category, stars, downloads, or maintenance signals.

## Primary method: dsh-market's live registry

If `dshmarket` is installed in the profile, load the same live curated catalog
the market UI uses:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
# A bare 'dshmarket/lib/registry.js' specifier FAILS: the package's "exports" map
# does not expose ./lib/* -> ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Import by file URL.
# Use FORWARD slashes in the embedded Windows path (backslashes get eaten as
# string escapes when the script is written to disk).
node --input-type=module - <<'REG'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
const m = await import(pathToFileURL('C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dshmarket/lib/registry.js').href)
const reg = await (m.loadRegistry ?? m.default.loadRegistry)()
console.log(reg.count, reg.updated, Object.keys(reg))
const items = reg.items ?? reg.plugins ?? []
REG
```

Registry record shape:

- `name`, `owner`, `url`, `category`
- `description.en`, `description.zh`
- `npm`, `tarball`, `install`, `added`
- `stars`, `downloads` (nullable; null means unknown, not zero)

## Fast path: the `category` field

Both catalogues carry a human-assigned `category`. `browser` (65 entries) is the
right starting pool for browser questions, but it MIXES real browser *control*
plugins with `web_search`/`web_fetch` *provider* plugins. Require a browser noun
AND a control verb; matching only 操控/控制 pulls in remote-control and
desktop-control plugins that never touch a browser.

## Filtering

- Search both `description.zh` and `description.en`, plus `name`, `url`, `npm`.
- Use word-boundary regexes for English words. `story` matches inside
  `history`, so prefer `\bstory\b`; simpler Chinese terms like `小说` are safe.
- After matching, manually drop false positives when the query is semantic
  (e.g., "history" plugins matching `story`, RPG themes mentioning "novels").

## Star data

The live registry can return `stars: null` for newer entries. Refresh via
GitHub API:

```js
const url = new URL(p.url)
const repo = [ ...url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean) ].slice(0, 2).join('/')
const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}`, {
  headers: { accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' }
})
const stars = res.ok ? (await res.json()).stargazers_count : p.stars
```

For monorepo entries, use the first two path segments (owner/repo), not the
subdirectory path.

If the API is rate-limited (anonymous ~60 req/h), fall back to the repo's
`releases.atom` RSS feed (`https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases.atom`)
or the release-tag HTML pages — both bypass the API limit.

## Sorting

Put null stars last:

```js
items.sort((a, b) => (b.stars ?? -1) - (a.stars ?? -1))
```

## Method 2: GitHub repository search (when the registry is thin or unavailable)

The local registry can come back empty in a script (`reg.items` undefined) and
only knows entries the market indexed. GitHub search finds the whole ecosystem, so
run it alongside — the user may also simply say "the plugins are on git".

```powershell
# pass the WHOLE url-encoded query as the path: -f q='... --profile ...' makes gh
# parse the value as flags, and --jq with \(...) is mangled by PowerShell.
gh api "search/repositories?q=dsh+plugin+deepseek-harness&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=25"
gh api "search/repositories?q=%22dsh+plugin+--profile%22+in%3Areadme&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=25"
```

Redirect the JSON to a file, re-encode it, then parse in node — an explicit `powershell.exe` (5.1)
writes UTF-16 and node's JSON.parse cannot read it. **The DSH `pwsh` tool is PowerShell 7.6.7 since
2026-10-15 and writes UTF-8, so the re-encode is only needed under 5.1:**

```powershell
$j = gh api "..." | Out-String
[IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\tmp\gh.json', $j, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('D:/tmp/gh.json','utf8')); for (const r of j.items) console.log(r.stargazers_count, r.full_name)"
```

### Reading the results

- **GitHub 只覆盖"开源代码"这一层；同一问题往往同时有"论文层"，而论文层能给出实证结论**。一次自建系统的"是否重复开发"核查里，GitHub 四路搜索全部命中 ≤2★ 的长尾，而**真正同题的既有工作是在会议论文里找到的**（ICML 2026）。⇒ 搜索面必须扩到会议虚拟站（`icml.cc/virtual/<year>/...`）、arXiv，并用**问题域**（不是产品名）作查询词（如 "visual memory agent"、"image lifecycle LLM"）。**会议摘要页常带 project page / code / OpenReview 链接**，是拿到代码与作者的捷径。
- **引用论文前必须验存在性**：搜索结果的标题列表里**混着幻觉条目**（本次 `2606.14106` 的引用格式可疑，遂核）。一条命令即可判真伪：
  `https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=ti:%22<精确标题>%22&max_results=5` —— 看 `totalResults` 与 `<entry><title>` 是否逐字一致；对不上就整条丢弃，**不要因为它在搜索引擎结果里就采信**。
- **覆盖面 ≠ 新颖性**（本会话被用户纠正的判断错误）：生态内"没有同类"**只证明这个平台没人做**，不证明没人做过。判"是否重复开发"要换到**问题域**这个尺度：先写清自己解决的是哪一类问题，再在别的生态里找同类做法。反例教训——按平台内标准，887★ 的视觉插件是生态头部，看起来"最大重合"；换到"AI 图片生命周期管理"这个域，它**根本不在同一赛道**（它把图发给外部视觉 API，解决的是"模型看不见"）。⇒ **先定赛道，再看重合度**；赛道定错会得出完全相反的结论。
- **Stars belong to the monorepo, not the entry.** One 7.6k-star project shows up as
  10 entries with the same count — rank PROJECTS, then pick the entry you need.
- **Aggregate-package peers** (the shape this family ships) are repos whose install
  line is a single npm bundle, often named `<scope>/<project>-all`, or a suite that
  installs an injector plus presets. Filter candidates by `p.npm`/`p.install`, then
  confirm by reading the repo's README install section.
- **Benchmarking their docs**: fetch `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/HEAD/README.md`
  and profile it before reading it — byte size, heading skeleton, badges, images,
  table rows, code fences, `<details>` count. Adopt the INFORMATION HIERARCHY
  (what it is → do I need it → fastest working path → daily use → control → failure
  → reference); reject the marketing devices (badge walls, star CTAs, centered HTML
  theater, cross-promo link farms). Copying those wholesale is the failure mode the
  user corrected once: extract what a reader gains, not what the peer displays.

## Capability questions ("does anything let DSH do X?")

Catalog blurbs lie about capability — every browser plugin "screenshots" without ever
touching the OS screen. Classify each candidate on TWO independent booleans read from
its README, never from the blurb:

- **performs the action** (capture / drive / write) vs merely consumes the artifact;
- **targets the requested platform** (Windows / macOS / Linux / a device).

The biggest false positives are high-star toolkits: a vision toolkit that *reads*
screenshots lists no capture tool. Open the README's tool inventory table and look for a
capture row; no capture row means no answer regardless of stars. Same trap: "browser page
screenshot" is not "OS screen capture", and Android / HarmonyOS / ROS / Godot captures are
different targets again.

### 能力不在 README 也不在工具表，在三处源码（2026-10-12 两次代码级核查的结论）

上一条说"打开 README 的工具清单表找 capture 行"——**那次核查证明这一层还是太高**。两个同域项目的代码级核查里，README/工具表给出的能力面**都被显著高估**：

| 看哪里 | 它决定什么 | 本次实例 |
|---|---|---|
| **数据模型里存了什么** | 什么**根本不可能**做到 | 一个项目只持久化 **64×64 WebP base64 缩略图**、另一个只存 **≤512px q85 有损 JPEG**，原图只记尺寸 ⇒ **像素级取用在其数据模型上不可能**，与它有多少工具无关 |
| **调用图（有没有人调到）** | 声明的能力里**多少是活的** | 一个项目 37 项能力中 **9 项零调用**（含全库唯一的"区域→像素"代码），`ttl` 未接线导致"持久行永不因龄过期"、`ocr_text` 列无写入点；另一个项目 **112 个工具**（README 声称 21）且语义轴依赖一个**缺失的模型文件**（仓库里是 15 字节文本 `Entry not found`，运行时找的又是另一个路径）⇒ 开箱即**静默零向量退化** |
| **工件形态（无损/有损、全量/缩略）** | 它的能力**服务于什么用途** | 两者都**从不落盘原始字节** ⇒ 它们是"分析结果缓存"，**不是归档**，谁也无法把一张图交回给消费者 |

⇒ 判据：**"能不能做 X"由数据模型判，"实际做不做 X"由调用图判，"做成什么样"由工件形态判**——三者都要读源码；README 与工具表只能用来**定位**这三处。凡只读到工具表就下的能力结论，一律标 `[推断]`。

### 子智能体的核查结论必须被主对话抽验（本次抓到一处反例）

派子智能体做代码级核查是有效手段，但**它的"证伪"也会错**：一次报告写"全仓无 sqlite/http 依赖"，抽验发现两个依赖都在（`rusqlite` 5 处引用、`reqwest` 15 处）——**结论方向对（那些声称的功能确实没实现），论据错（依赖存在，只是用在别处：域凭据保险库与资产下载）**。⇒ 主对话至少抽验**最要命的那一条**（决定进门/出门的那条），并把抽验命令与结果一并留痕；子智能体的 `文件:行` 是抽验的入口，不是可信度凭证。

Keep per-candidate evidence (win / capture / macOnly) plus raw hit counts, so an excluded
1200-star repo can be justified rather than silently dropped.

## Installed-plane questions ("what is installed here?" / "which plugin gives X?")

Catalog work answers what EXISTS; these questions are answered from the machine, and the
answer must split **platform-shipped** from **third-party installed** — the user checks
that split first. Authoritative sources, in order:

1. `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` — `dependencies` AND `dsh.profile.bundles`
   (a dependency absent from `bundles` is installed but never mounted; the reverse also
   happens, so read both).
2. `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` (+ `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`) —
   `disabled:` flags, `insert:` rows, MCP rows. Each row `id` is what a boot log names.
3. `node_modules/<pkg>/package.json` — the REAL installed version (never the range in
   `dependencies`), and its `dsh.bundle.patch` names the rows it inserts.
4. Platform bundles (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `dsh-web-app`, `dsh-experimental-*`) are
   NOT in the profile's `node_modules`; they resolve from the dsh bundled inside the app's
   `resources/app.asar`. Report them as platform-provided, never as installs.
5. Live state: the host process command line names the profile dir it booted with, and
   every config mtime must be ≤ that boot time before calling the report "currently live".

**Capability attribution** ("is there a plugin that does X?") — grep the installed
packages for the capability's real identifiers, open the implementation at its trigger
site, then name the owning plane. A hit that only *parses another tool's logs about* the
capability is not an implementation of it. Grep list and worked example:
`references/local-installed-plane.md`.

**Mount-topology trap**: a GUI-plane (`web-app`) patch can `disabled: true` rows the base
bundle inserted, moving the real mount into **agent-preset** scope. Profile-root patches
cannot reach rows inside a preset — behaviour changes mean editing the preset file. The
`minimal` preset mounts no compaction at all, so "the platform supports X" ≠ "this
session has X". Check the preset before claiming a capability is live.

## Filtering on the FORM of a tool's return value

Catalog blurbs describe what a plugin *does*, never what it *returns* — so "capture the
screen" looks identical whether the tool hands back an image block or just a file path.
When the requirement is about payload form (raw image vs path vs text), the curated
catalog cannot answer it: read each candidate's README and look for a pipeline diagram
(saveImage() -> image content block -> model) or an explicit counter-claim ("passes a
path, not an image"). In one sweep of 2710 curated entries, ZERO declared an image
return — the only explicit statement was a path-only disclaimer. Expect this axis to
require per-repo reads.

A helper that calls api.github.com fails *silently* without a token: the anonymous budget
(60/h) exhausts easily, and a retry loop then reports every repo as unfetchable, which
reads exactly like "these repositories do not exist". Prefix such commands with
`$env:GH_TOKEN = (gh auth token);` and distinguish 403 (rate limit) from 404 (absent)
before drawing any conclusion.

# DSH 插件扩展点设计（设计期）

给 DSH 插件设计「什么归我、什么归宿主、扩展点长什么样」。这是**设计期**审计：在写第一行代码之前，把每个实体（代码、状态、清单、可见性、版本）指派给一个已有所有者，并证明这个插件比平台已有机制多提供了什么。它不判版本兼容（那归 `dsh-plugin-compatibility`），不判模型可见性怎么走（那归 `dsh-context-visibility`）。

## When to Use

- 「我要把它做成一个 X 系统／框架／管理器」——尤其当 X 已经是一个平台概念时（技能、插件、文档、工具集）。
- 「支持长期保存 + 随用随删」「支持多版本」「支持按场景自由选择子集」——这类需求同时出现时。
- 「这个接口是不是该做成 MCP」或「要不要自己存一份清单」。
- 给一个已经能用的插件加**新扩展点**（新工具、新技能、新后端）之前。

## Prerequisites

- 平台源码树：读接口与所有权，不读 README 的架构段。
- 宿主上**真正在跑**的那份实现：判定「平台已有什么」时以它为准。
- 最宽松的那一档配置（本机＝Creator 模式）到底给模型哪些工具——这条决定「模型能不能自己选」。

## How to Run

按顺序答。**先答第 1 条，答错它后面全废**：

1. **先分清「架构模式」与「实现外壳」。** 参考物是论文仓／实验仓时尤其如此：目录结构是被实验需求塑造的，架构是那份「core + 可扩展 + 子集选择」的骨架。两者分开审，答案常常相反（骨架成立、管理器不成立，或者反过来）。
2. **逐实体问：有几个消费者必须对同一事实达成一致？** 必须一致（多消费者读同一事实）⇒ 唯一真品，进 core，配机械闸（错误码表、地址派生、坐标系、准入映射）。只有一个消费者 ⇒ 共享模块即可，不做注册表、不做协议。
3. **逐实体问：这件事宿主是不是已经有所有者？** 一次问清五面——代码、状态、清单、可见性、版本。任一面宿主已有 ⇒ 用它的面，你只写自己那一层（加载与校验）。
4. **要「模型可调」的能力，先查宿主有没有现成的角色面**（例：运行期工具可见性＝`tools.restrict` 的作用域 restriction 面；文档生命周期＝技能层）。有面而没有手 ⇒ **先分清是「宿主没有那只手」还是「那只手只能在别的时刻握」**。本会话实测的陷阱：我曾建议「写一个插件工具去调 `tools.restrict`」——但工具体里的 `exec.agent` 是 bare Agent（公开 `Agent` 接口只有 `id`，`packages/core/agent/src/types.ts:15-18`），而 `restrict()` 无作用域直接抛（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:1097-1101`）。平台自己的做法是**在 per-agent 资源生命周期里造作用域**（`createScope(ctx, agent)`，`packages/core/scope/src/index.ts:137`；生产样例 `packages/experimental/browser-use-runtime/src/mcp.ts:117`），或在**内建的创建窗**落地（子 agent 的 `toolFilter`，`packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:218`）。⇒ **可见性归谁，取决于指令由谁握**：工具体里那只是**调用者自己的**作用域 ⇒ **子 agent 可以自选自己的可见子集**；
   父级"能否 deny 子作用域里的工具"只在**部署期两臂**那条路上才相关（父级此时还没见过子级自注册的名字），**不是关键问题**。
   两条随之而来的纪律：① 自选必须落在**回合边界**并保持稳定（一次选择＝系统提示前缀归一化一次）；② **别让选择器被自己的 restriction 吃掉**
   —— restriction 只过滤继承面，所以要么把选择器注册在作用域内（scope-local 不受过滤），要么在 allow 里显式带它（防"选窄之后自锁"）。
5. **扩展点的形态由「它是什么」决定：** 数据／算子型（进程内纯函数）＝文件系统 + 契约校验 + 注册；作用域型＝宿主的作用域 API；服务型（跨宿主、跨语言、要隔离）＝才轮到 MCP。**MCP 是边缘 provider 的形态，不是框架的身份。**
6. **查依赖方向**：core 绝不 import 具体扩展，扩展只依赖 core。这条坏了，架子会烂在第二个扩展上。
7. **只留下「需要用户拍的结构决定」**（通常一条），其余按最小实现最广适配自行取舍，不逐项请示。

## Quick Reference — 实体归属表（0.2.0-rc.2 实测）

| 实体 | 所有者 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| 代码（新工具／算子） | 文件系统（可选 git） | 约定目录 + manifest；插件只加载与校验 |
| 版本历史（**本地惯例，非平台契约**） | **第三方 evolution 层**在用户技能根下自建的账 | `$DSH_HOME/skills/.history/skills/<name>/index.json`（`{v,at,action,hash,chars,beforeHash?,path?}`）＋ `.history/blobs/<sha256>`（实测 1158 个）＋ `.usage.json` ＋ `.archive/`；★ 这些名字在**平台仓 `packages/`、`scripts/` 里零命中**——它们是**本机装的插件（`@lmzhen/dsh-evolution-*`）的私有约定**，不是 DSH 平台承诺。⇒ 引用前先问：这是平台契约，还是本机某个插件的行为？ |
| 技能撰写／管理 | evolution 层的 `skill_manage` | 动作＝`create/edit/update/patch/delete/write_file/remove_file/restructure/pin/unpin/review/list`；`.usage.json` 记 `state/pinned/archived_at/use_count/patch_count` |
| 删除 | **归档，不是物理删** | `delete` 把目录移进 `$DSH_HOME/skills/.archive/<name>/`，`.usage.json` 置 `state:"archived"`＋`archived_at`；**没有安装命令** ⇒ 「随用随删」＝直接 `fs` 删目录 |

| 清单（有哪些） | 从目录现算，不落盘 | 落盘＝第二真相源（本仓曾因缓存 id 列表随宿主重启变化，把 `viewFor` 整个删掉） |
| 工具可见性 | 宿主作用域 restriction；申请者只需**握有那个作用域**，而在工具体里握有的就是**调用者自己的** | `ToolRuntime.restrict({allow\|deny})`（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:1097`，无 scoped ctx 直接抛；**过滤的是继承面，作用域自身注册不受影响** `:1194-1208`）。`agent.ctx` **存在且是 agent-local**：`packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts:174` `readonly ctx: Context`（原话：agent-scoped，disposal 时回卷、之后拒绝注册）；作用域键就是 agent id —— `ctx.agents.resolve(sessionId) → this.get(sessionId)`（`core/agent/src/index.ts:263`）与 `typert.contexts.registerHost('agent', … resolve: sessionId => this.get(sessionId)?.ctx)`（`:268`），与插件侧 `sessionIdOf(exec.agent) = agent.id`（`lib/session-rows.js:88-91`）**同一个键**。`[已闭环复核]`：源码树里那两个文件不在部分检出内，但**已安装的编译产物**给了同一结论 —— `dsh-tools/lib/index.js:1201` `agent: exec.agent`（工具执行体真的拿到 live agent）、`:1402` `registry.schemas(exec.agent)`（平台自己把它当 agent 用）、`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1889` `setup?.(prepared.agent.ctx, prepared.agent)`（**运行时 agent 确实带 `.ctx`**）、`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2895-2910` 的 `restrict` 实现（`scopeOf(this.ctx)`／空 filter 抛／**`run_code` 一律拒**／名字须在 `restrictableNames`／经 `layers.effect` 返回 disposer）。⇒ 「工具体里 `exec.agent.ctx.tools` 可用」**有据**，不再是转述。**形态结论（本轮拍定）**：作用域是在**执行时**由 `scopeOf(this.ctx)` 取的 ⇒ **一个全局注册的工具，父与子共用同一个，谁在调就作用于谁** —— 不需要 `createScope`、不需要父级代选、不需要按角色各做一个 |
| 包／插件生命周期 | 宿主 plugin manager | 工具名 `plugin_manager`（`packages/boot/plugin-manager/src/tools.ts:20`），每次动作需 `danger-full-access` 或审批 |
| 技能发现 | 技能层的文件系统 provider | `packages/skill/skill-filesystem/src/index.ts:676-729`（`SKILL.md`），变更发 `skills/change` |
| 技能支持文件 | 技能包本身 | 正文旁 `references/` `scripts/` `templates/` `assets/`（`SUPPORT_DIRS`，由 evolution 层的 `evolution-core` 定义；平台仓里 grep 不到属正常） |
| 扩展点的身份 | 派生哈希 + 版本号进返回值 | 平台硬规矩 model-visible ⟺ logged：新可见面必须能从日志重建 |

| **技能层能承载什么** | 技能层＝文档／指令载体，**不是工具注册** | 模型侧的 `skill` 工具只**返回文本**（`packages/skill/tool-skill/src/index.ts:122-127,198`：`render: (_a,v) => [{type:'text', text: renderSkillContent(v)}]`，无 execute 步骤）⇒ 支持目录（`scripts/` 等）是**素材**，不是可执行技能。**别把 VISTA 的"skill（可执行工具集）"与 DSH 的"skill（SKILL.md）"当同一物**——这条同名异实会让"算子该不该做成技能"整题问错 |

## Pitfalls

- **问错层级是最贵的错。** 用户问「架构形态对不对」，你去审「它是不是一个管理器」⇒ 证据再对也是答非所问。落地法：动手查之前先用一句话写下你的判题，跟用户原话对一遍。
- **被参考物的目录结构牵着走。** 论文仓／实验仓的 `benchmarks/`、`profiles.py` 是实验外壳；按「层 + 子集选择」这个骨架看，别按目录看。
- **不要用「宿主已有那个生命周期」去否定参考物的架构。** 这两句可以同时成立：骨架照搬，管理器不必自建。
- **★★ 判「平台能不能做 X」之前，先跑一遍全量接口面，再下判词。** 本会话实测翻车：我据**一条子路径的类型面**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/types` 的 `Agent` 只有 `id`）判「插件拿不到调用者作用域」，并对用户说了这条结论；后来普查平台自动生成的接口目录（`packages/extensions/tool-cordis/src/api-catalog.ts`：91 服务／503 公开方法／81 事件）才发现在**包根的类型增补**里 `Agent` 另有 `readonly ctx: Context`。三条判据：①引用要走**包根**的面，不是某个子路径的再导出；②「做不到」这类否定必须跑完全量清单再写；③目录（catalog／README）只用于**发现候选**，结论必须回源码读实现——而**本机平台树可能是部分检出**（实测：`core/agent/src` 只有 9 个文件，别人引的 `tool-calls.ts`／`agent.ts` 不存在）⇒ 引用转述链时标 `[未逐行复核]`，并把「我独立复核的是哪两头」写出来。 进程内纯函数（图像算子、统计、格式转换）走 MCP 只是多一层进程边界与序列化；MCP 的正当理由是「要在别的宿主／语言里跑」。
- **别把「本机某个插件的私有账」当成平台契约。** 本会话实测翻车：`.history/blobs`、`.usage.json`、`.archive/` 被当成技能层的版本账与归档契约，实际上**平台仓里零命中**，它们是用户根下某个 evolution 插件的实现细节；平台的技能层只有 `SkillDefinition.content`（Markdown 正文）。**判据：宣称「平台已有 X」之前，先在平台仓里 grep 到它**；只在本机看到过它 ⇒ 那是本机环境事实，不是可依赖的契约。
- **别重建平台已有的记忆／文档／清单。** 动手前先问：文件系统能不能存？git 能不能留版本？技能层能不能带支持文件？三者皆能 ⇒ 你要写的只有加载、校验与那份契约。
- **给还没有第二个消费者的东西提前做注册表／协议**，代价是每个新扩展都要改三处。等第二个真实扩展出现再抽象。
- **写盘代理不要自动提交、不要替用户建仓。** 先给可逆路径（备份／分支／未提交），再给动作。
- **源码树读不动时，去读宿主上**已安装的编译产物**。** 部分检出／asar 打包会让人误判"平台没有这个"：先 `rg -l <符号>` 或按**文件名**在宿主 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/**`（含 `.asar.unpacked` 与 npm 全局）里找 **`.js` 而不只是 `.ts`** —— 编译产物**剥掉了类型**，实现反而更直白。本会话靠它闭环了三处关键事实（`agent.ctx` 可否到达、`restrict` 的确切行为、工具执行体拿到的是 live agent），并在技能库里把 `[未逐行复核]` 改成 `[已闭环复核]`。**判据**：源码树里 grep 不到 ≠ 平台没有；换一棵树（检出／编译／已安装）再判，并把读的是哪一棵写进结论。
- **调用平台内建校验时，把它抛的文案当公共接口对待。** 例：`tools.restrict` 会替使用者报三类错 —— 无作用域（`requires a scoped context (agent.ctx)`）、空 filter（`is a no-op`）、保留名（`cannot name reserved PTC mode presentation transport "run_code"`），未知名还会把**已知全局名集合**一并列出来。自己不要另造同义错误文案；先试调、把平台的拒答当契约，能少写一套平行校验。
- **审批墙是前置事实，不是事故。** 凡「装包／改 profile／执行生成代码」的路径，先问它要不要审批、是否只在最宽松模式免批；不可逆动作要有回退路径。
- **改一个子系统的"表现"时，要连它的**执行面**一起改。** 加一个工具（或一个模块）会撞到的不是代码，而是一组互相交叉的校验面：装配点（注册 ＋ deps 注入）、出参**方言**（平台只收一个子集，写错＝整个插件不激活）、**错误码表**、契约测试的**覆盖面守卫**（"按磁盘推导、防静默漏检"）。**判据**：动手前先 grep 出全部钉住这一次改动的断言与闸（"5 个工具"这类数字最容易漏），改完让它们显式报红一次再放绿 —— 清单见 references/adding-a-tool-checklist.md。
- **`inject` 是硬闸，诊断量走可选访问。** `inject` 里列的服务缺席 ⇒ 插件**不加载**（cordis 的 required inject 无超时）⇒ 为了让一个**可选的诊断量**可用而把它加进 `inject`，等于把整个插件绑死在那个部署上。例：为了读"会话面"的 `contentGeneration` 而注入 `sessions`，会让没有该服务的部署**整个插件不加载**。正解＝装配点用 `ctx.get('<service>')?.<member>?.…` **逐层可选**，任一层缺席即 `undefined`，并在消费侧把它当 `unknown`（fail-open）。平台自己的 `ctx.attachments?.imageLimits` 就是这个形态。
- **公开面只有计数器时，就用计数器当"变了没有"的信号。** `SessionSurface` 只导出 `{nodes, replaceGeneration, contentGeneration}` —— **`projectedMessages` 不在公开面上** ⇒ 想查"某个块是不是已被投影替换"（如 `image/offload` 的占位符）就得自己去读会话日志并折叠，那是与平台重复的第二套机制。替代：平台的每次 `project` 都会让 `contentGeneration` 前进（`replace` 也前进，`append` 不前进）⇒ 把它当作**"面变没变"的粗粒度信号**：不同即重做，相同就用缓存结论。**代价是它会被无关变更推动**（偏保守、可能多做一次），但只要"重做"永远安全，这就是对的方向。

### 收窄参数的作用域比你想象的大：`allow` 是**整张面**的白名单（实测踩过，已发布缺陷）

- 症状：一个"只收窄自己命名空间"的选择器，发 `tools.restrict({ allow: [自己的名字…] })` ⇒ **调用者当场丢掉 preset 给的其它工具**（read／write／bash／MCP 全部变 `unknown tool`）。
- 机制：`allow` 的语义是 **keep only**，作用在**继承面（全局层＋祖先层）整张表**上，不是"与你给的名字取交集"；`deny` 才是外科式的（只摘点名的）。平台文档原话见 `Restrict **global** tools … allow (keep only)`；凭名字猜语义会猜反。
- **最快的判据是平台自带的测试**（不是注释）：`packages/core/tools/tests/scoped.spec.ts` 里正面断言 `restrict({ allow: ['read'] })` ⇒ `bash` 变 `Error: unknown tool "bash"`，而作用域内自注册的 `capture` **仍在**。凡"过滤参数"先找平台自己的测试，看它断言了什么被去掉。
- 修法与守门断言：改发 `deny`＝**自己命名空间内的补集**；再把 deny 与平台真值（`tools.schemas(agent)` 的当前名字）取交，避免未注册名让 `restrict` 抛 unknown。测试替身要**放一个别人的工具进去**，并断言"别人的工具一个都不许进 deny"——否则替身太干净，这类整面误伤永远不会红。

### 工具可见性的两半：注册可按 agent，收窄只认全局（0.2.0-rc.2 实测）

- `tools.register(definition)` 的文档原话：*Register globally or in the calling agent scope. Scoped tools shadow globals; duplicates within one layer and the reserved run_code name fail.* ⇒ **运行期造出来的工具可以按 agent 注册**（同名遮蔽全局），并返回精确的 disposer。
- `tools.restrict(filter)` 的文档原话：*Restrict **global** tools for the calling agent scope. … scope-local names … fail. Restrictions intersect; **scoped registrations remain visible**.* ⇒ **收窄是一张全局工具掩码，够不到 agent 作用域里的注册**。
- ⇒ 由此推出一条设计级取舍：要让模型"造工具"，注册层只能二选一 —— **全局注册**（可被收窄治理，但对所有 agent 可见）或 **按 agent 注册**（隔离正确，但模型的"多选"管不到它）。平台不提供第三条路；把这一点写进方案，别指望后面补一个开关。
- `run_code` 在两处都是保留名：注册不能用它（`tool name "run_code" is reserved …`）、收窄名单里也不许出现它。

## 把文案搬进字典 ≠ 改个名字：按"哪一层握着翻译器"分工（2026-08-13 实测）

- **症状**：为了"用户面文案必须来自字典"，直接把 `t('key')` 写进产生文案的那一层 —— 而那一层（控制器／状态机／纯逻辑）**根本没有 `t`**：它是模块作用域函数，翻译器只在组件渲染时才注入。结果是整块功能抛 `ReferenceError`，五条测试同时红。
- **机制**：翻译器是**渲染边界**才有的依赖（组件从 props／apply 作用域拿到 `t`），逻辑层拿不到也不该拿。
- **正确分工**：*模型层存**键**，边界层做**翻译***——`failed = { kind: 'transport', key: 'save.failedTransport' }`，渲染处 `t(failed.key)`。同理，kit 里的展示型函数要么**收 `t` 作为参数**（与"字段 spec 都带 `t`"的既有约定一致），要么由调用方在渲染时翻译；**不要让展示函数去闭包捕获一个它拿不到的 `t`**。
- **判据**：逻辑层的返回值里**不应出现面向用户的句子**（只有键、码、枚举）；渲染层**不应出现自然语言字面量**。两条都能机械检查：前者查"逻辑层字符串里有没有成句的中文/英文"，后者就是命名闸。

## Pluggable capabilities: declare as frozen data, bind the implementation separately (2026-10-13)

- **Split the declaration from the implementation.** The declaration is **serializable data** (`{id, api_version, summary, params, produces, effect, numeric}`), carries **no function reference**, and is returned **frozen**; the implementation is bound in a registry keyed by `id@api_version`. Why: only data can be printed, diffed, put in a return value or generate another artifact (an input schema, a description, a digest) — and "which implementation produced this reading" must be answerable from the value alone.
- **Validate strictly and loudly**: reject **unknown fields** (a declaration is a contract; every extra field is one more truth nobody checks), reject duplicate parameter names, require `enum` values to match the declared `type`, reject `min > max`, and keep enumerated vocabularies **closed** (a token outside the list is free text, not a declaration).
- **Registry guards worth copying** (they mirror what the host does for its own registries): refuse a declaration that **is not frozen** (otherwise a caller smuggles in an unvalidated object and the contract claim breaks), refuse a non-function implementation, and refuse a **duplicate key** (a duplicate means someone believes they changed the implementation when they did not). Keep enumeration order = registration order, so generated artifacts (enums, descriptions) do not jitter between runs.
- **Payoff**: with the contract layer in a directory that is *forbidden to import anything*, the whole layer becomes directly unit-testable with no doubles — contract errors go red before any consumer runs.

## A contractually import-free layer decides where shared data lives (2026-10-13)

- Symptom: a new `builtin.js` in the *pure* directory imported its sibling (`./spec.js`) for the validator ⇒ the repo's own absolute rule ("this directory imports nothing, ever") went red on the next check.
- Fix (and the only compliant shape): move the shared declarations **into the module that already owns the validator** and export them from there. Do not split "data" and "validation" across two files inside an import-free directory — the constraint is directory-wide, not per-file.
- Generalization: when a layer is declared import-free, every shared constant, default table or built-in declaration must live **inside one of that layer's own modules**; a new sibling file that imports anything is a violation by construction. Read the rule before choosing the file layout — the rule is stated in the checker, and it is cheaper to obey it than to argue with it.
- Second-order effect worth knowing: consumers in other layers (assembly, test doubles, tests that build their own dependency object) should all reference the **same exported object** rather than re-declaring it; duplicated declarations drift silently, and no test notices.

## A self-describing field whose reference does not exist yet must be deferred — on the record (2026-10-13)

- Situation: a return value is supposed to carry an implementation digest ("which build of this operator produced this reading"). For built-in operators the implementation is **spread across several modules**, so there is no single addressable source text to digest.
- The wrong move is to synthesize one anyway: a digest over *something adjacent* produces a precisely formatted value that cannot answer the question it exists for — worse than an absent field, because readers trust it.
- The right move: **defer the field, and write down where it becomes meaningful** (here: once operators exist as loaded source files, each with one addressable text). Record it as a deliberate deferral with its reason, in the same ledger as the delivered items — so a later reader can tell "not done yet, on purpose" apart from "forgotten".
- Companion: when the referent *does* exist, put the identity in the value **and** the key and assert their sameness in a test — two places deriving the same identity is exactly where silent divergence starts.

## Name a result field after what it is — a `code` slot becomes an error code downstream (2026-10-13)

- Symptom: a comparability verdict (`channel-mismatch`) was returned in a field named `code`. Semantically it is an **alignment value**, not an error: it means "these two cannot be compared", which the caller returns as `alignment`. But the repo's error-code gate scans every `code:` position and demanded the literal be registered in the error-code table — a false obligation created purely by the field name.
- Fix: rename the field to what it is (`alignment`). The gate noise disappears and the semantics stop lying; the caller composes `alignment: verdict.alignment`.
- Generalization: a field name is a **contract with the whole toolchain** — validators, tables, docs and gate rules key off names like `code`, `id`, `digest`, `version`. Putting a value in a slot whose name promises something else creates obligations (and false failures) far from the point of origin. Fix the name, not the checker.

## Split the shaping half from the calling half — and reuse vocabulary before coining it (2026-10-13)

- **Rule 1 (testability)**: a capability that both *shapes a declaration* and *calls the host* should be built as two pieces: a **pure** piece that produces the exact data the host will consume (tool name, description, parameter map, output schema/render), and a thin piece that performs the call and the post-call check. Reason: the shaping piece decides **what the model actually sees**, yet if it lives inside the calling function it can never be covered by fast unit tests — and it is where the interesting defects live (wrong wrapper shape, missing `render`, over-long name).
- **Rule 2 (vocabulary)**: before inventing a new identifier (error code, status literal, field name), search the existing vocabulary for one with the same meaning. Measured: a freshly coined `op_not_recomputable_scope` immediately triggered the repo's error-code ledger gate (every emitted code must be registered) *and* risked confusion with an existing **success-branch field** of similar name. Reusing the already-registered `no_session_scope` satisfied the gate, kept the vocabulary small, and read better. Coining an identifier is never free: it creates registration duties and collision risk at every downstream consumer.

## LLM 任务的载体选择：先问"证据筛选由谁做"（2026-10-16 实测）

给插件里的一段判断选载体时，真正的分岔**不是**"子智能体 vs 单次结构化调用"，而是**证据筛选归谁**：

- **单次结构化调用**擅长可比、可记录、可跨版本对照的判断，但它**不会自己找证据** —— 你得先把决定性那几段挑出来；
- **子智能体**擅长**导航**（自己决定读哪段、要不要翻 `references/`、逐条引 `path:line`），代价是 token/延迟不可预测、
  探索路径每次不同 ⇒ 同一输入在不同轮次可能给出不同判决，台账失去可比性。

实测（判一对技能是否该合并，44 个技能的库）：整篇正文中位 **26.6k tokens/对** → 头部抽取（description ＋ 引言段 ＋
"何时用" ＋ 边界）压到 **9%**（约 1k tokens/对）；头部与整篇的**排序相关性 0.668**，而**仅 description ≈ 0（-0.022）**。
⇒ 可用的形制是**三级级联 + 三选项 schema**（`1 需合并 / 0 信息不足 / -1 不需合并`）：L0 只喂名字+描述+各级分数
（早期退出；`1` 与 `0` 都上送，因为 L0 的 `1` 不足以定案）→ L1 喂头部抽取（**只有 `0` 上送**）→ L2 喂正文关键段或子智能体取证。
三级输出**同一 schema**，每条记 `level` 与 `trail` —— 否则无法区分"判决变化来自语料"还是"来自采样/探索路径"。
⇒ 周期性插件里的分配：**主力单次调用**（成本可预测、台账可比），**子智能体只做少数升级**（证据被截断、低置信、两向矛盾）。

# DSH 插件扩展点设计（设计期）

给 DSH 插件设计「什么归我、什么归宿主、扩展点长什么样」。这是**设计期**审计：在写第一行代码之前，把每个实体（代码、状态、清单、可见性、版本）指派给一个已有所有者，并证明这个插件比平台已有机制多提供了什么。它不判版本兼容（那归 `dsh-plugin-compatibility`），不判模型可见性怎么走（那归 `dsh-context-visibility`）。

- 「我要把它做成一个 X 系统／框架／管理器」——尤其当 X 已经是一个平台概念时（技能、插件、文档、工具集）。
- 「支持长期保存 + 随用随删」「支持多版本」「支持按场景自由选择子集」——这类需求同时出现时。
- 「这个接口是不是该做成 MCP」或「要不要自己存一份清单」。
- 给一个已经能用的插件加**新扩展点**（新工具、新技能、新后端）之前。

- 平台源码树：读接口与所有权，不读 README 的架构段。
- 宿主上**真正在跑**的那份实现：判定「平台已有什么」时以它为准。
- 最宽松的那一档配置（本机＝Creator 模式）到底给模型哪些工具——这条决定「模型能不能自己选」。

按顺序答。**先答第 1 条，答错它后面全废**：

1. **先分清「架构模式」与「实现外壳」。** 参考物是论文仓／实验仓时尤其如此：目录结构是被实验需求塑造的，架构是那份「core + 可扩展 + 子集选择」的骨架。两者分开审，答案常常相反（骨架成立、管理器不成立，或者反过来）。
2. **逐实体问：有几个消费者必须对同一事实达成一致？** 必须一致（多消费者读同一事实）⇒ 唯一真品，进 core，配机械闸（错误码表、地址派生、坐标系、准入映射）。只有一个消费者 ⇒ 共享模块即可，不做注册表、不做协议。
3. **逐实体问：这件事宿主是不是已经有所有者？** 一次问清五面——代码、状态、清单、可见性、版本。任一面宿主已有 ⇒ 用它的面，你只写自己那一层（加载与校验）。
4. **要「模型可调」的能力，先查宿主有没有现成的角色面**（例：运行期工具可见性＝`tools.restrict` 的作用域 restriction 面；文档生命周期＝技能层）。有面而没有手 ⇒ **先分清是「宿主没有那只手」还是「那只手只能在别的时刻握」**。本会话实测的陷阱：我曾建议「写一个插件工具去调 `tools.restrict`」——但工具体里的 `exec.agent` 是 bare Agent（公开 `Agent` 接口只有 `id`，`packages/core/agent/src/types.ts:15-18`），而 `restrict()` 无作用域直接抛（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:1097-1101`）。平台自己的做法是**在 per-agent 资源生命周期里造作用域**（`createScope(ctx, agent)`，`packages/core/scope/src/index.ts:137`；生产样例 `packages/experimental/browser-use-runtime/src/mcp.ts:117`），或在**内建的创建窗**落地（子 agent 的 `toolFilter`，`packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:218`）。⇒ **可见性归谁，取决于指令由谁握**：工具体里那只是**调用者自己的**作用域 ⇒ **子 agent 可以自选自己的可见子集**；
   父级"能否 deny 子作用域里的工具"只在**部署期两臂**那条路上才相关（父级此时还没见过子级自注册的名字），**不是关键问题**。
   两条随之而来的纪律：① 自选必须落在**回合边界**并保持稳定（一次选择＝系统提示前缀归一化一次）；② **别让选择器被自己的 restriction 吃掉**
   —— restriction 只过滤继承面，所以要么把选择器注册在作用域内（scope-local 不受过滤），要么在 allow 里显式带它（防"选窄之后自锁"）。
5. **扩展点的形态由「它是什么」决定：** 数据／算子型（进程内纯函数）＝文件系统 + 契约校验 + 注册；作用域型＝宿主的作用域 API；服务型（跨宿主、跨语言、要隔离）＝才轮到 MCP。**MCP 是边缘 provider 的形态，不是框架的身份。**
6. **查依赖方向**：core 绝不 import 具体扩展，扩展只依赖 core。这条坏了，架子会烂在第二个扩展上。
7. **只留下「需要用户拍的结构决定」**（通常一条），其余按最小实现最广适配自行取舍，不逐项请示。

| **技能层能承载什么** | 技能层＝文档／指令载体，**不是工具注册** | 模型侧的 `skill` 工具只**返回文本**（`packages/skill/tool-skill/src/index.ts:122-127,198`：`render: (_a,v) => [{type:'text', text: renderSkillContent(v)}]`，无 execute 步骤）⇒ 支持目录（`scripts/` 等）是**素材**，不是可执行技能。**别把 VISTA 的"skill（可执行工具集）"与 DSH 的"skill（SKILL.md）"当同一物**——这条同名异实会让"算子该不该做成技能"整题问错 |
| 工具集的**变化**本身 | 前缀缓存（平台账） | 注册／注销／限制变化都会 `emit(tools/change)`（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:201,208`，**UNFILTERED**），任何变化＝系统提示前缀归一化一次 ⇒ **扩展现能不能做成"会增减的工具"** |

- **问错层级是最贵的错。** 用户问「架构形态对不对」，你去审「它是不是一个管理器」⇒ 证据再对也是答非所问。落地法：动手查之前先用一句话写下你的判题，跟用户原话对一遍。
- **被参考物的目录结构牵着走。** 论文仓／实验仓的 `benchmarks/`、`profiles.py` 是实验外壳；按「层 + 子集选择」这个骨架看，别按目录看。
- **不要用「宿主已有那个生命周期」去否定参考物的架构。** 这两句可以同时成立：骨架照搬，管理器不必自建。
- **★★ 判「平台能不能做 X」之前，先跑一遍全量接口面，再下判词。** 本会话实测翻车：我据**一条子路径的类型面**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/types` 的 `Agent` 只有 `id`）判「插件拿不到调用者作用域」，并对用户说了这条结论；后来普查平台自动生成的接口目录（`packages/extensions/tool-cordis/src/api-catalog.ts`：91 服务／503 公开方法／81 事件）才发现在**包根的类型增补**里 `Agent` 另有 `readonly ctx: Context`。三条判据：①引用要走**包根**的面，不是某个子路径的再导出；②「做不到」这类否定必须跑完全量清单再写；③目录（catalog／README）只用于**发现候选**，结论必须回源码读实现——而**本机平台树可能是部分检出**（实测：`core/agent/src` 只有 9 个文件，别人引的 `tool-calls.ts`／`agent.ts` 不存在）⇒ 引用转述链时标 `[未逐行复核]`，并把「我独立复核的是哪两头」写出来。 进程内纯函数（图像算子、统计、格式转换）走 MCP 只是多一层进程边界与序列化；MCP 的正当理由是「要在别的宿主／语言里跑」。
- **别把「本机某个插件的私有账」当成平台契约。** 本会话实测翻车：`.history/blobs`、`.usage.json`、`.archive/` 被当成技能层的版本账与归档契约，实际上**平台仓里零命中**，它们是用户根下某个 evolution 插件的实现细节；平台的技能层只有 `SkillDefinition.content`（Markdown 正文）。**判据：宣称「平台已有 X」之前，先在平台仓里 grep 到它**；只在本机看到过它 ⇒ 那是本机环境事实，不是可依赖的契约。
- **别重建平台已有的记忆／文档／清单。** 动手前先问：文件系统能不能存？git 能不能留版本？技能层能不能带支持文件？三者皆能 ⇒ 你要写的只有加载、校验与那份契约。
- **给还没有第二个消费者的东西提前做注册表／协议**，代价是每个新扩展都要改三处。等第二个真实扩展出现再抽象。
- **写盘代理不要自动提交、不要替用户建仓。** 先给可逆路径（备份／分支／未提交），再给动作。
- **源码树读不动时，去读宿主上**已安装的编译产物**。** 部分检出／asar 打包会让人误判"平台没有这个"：先 `rg -l <符号>` 或按**文件名**在宿主 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/**`（含 `.asar.unpacked` 与 npm 全局）里找 **`.js` 而不只是 `.ts`** —— 编译产物**剥掉了类型**，实现反而更直白。本会话靠它闭环了三处关键事实（`agent.ctx` 可否到达、`restrict` 的确切行为、工具执行体拿到的是 live agent），并在技能库里把 `[未逐行复核]` 改成 `[已闭环复核]`。**判据**：源码树里 grep 不到 ≠ 平台没有；换一棵树（检出／编译／已安装）再判，并把读的是哪一棵写进结论。
- **调用平台内建校验时，把它抛的文案当公共接口对待。** 例：`tools.restrict` 会替使用者报三类错 —— 无作用域（`requires a scoped context (agent.ctx)`）、空 filter（`is a no-op`）、保留名（`cannot name reserved PTC mode presentation transport "run_code"`），未知名还会把**已知全局名集合**一并列出来。自己不要另造同义错误文案；先试调、把平台的拒答当契约，能少写一套平行校验。
- **审批墙是前置事实，不是事故。** 凡「装包／改 profile／执行生成代码」的路径，先问它要不要审批、是否只在最宽松模式免批；不可逆动作要有回退路径。
- **改一个子系统的"表现"时，要连它的**执行面**一起改。** 加一个工具（或一个模块）会撞到的不是代码，而是一组互相交叉的校验面：装配点（注册 ＋ deps 注入）、出参**方言**（平台只收一个子集，写错＝整个插件不激活）、**错误码表**、契约测试的**覆盖面守卫**（"按磁盘推导、防静默漏检"）。**判据**：动手前先 grep 出全部钉住这一次改动的断言与闸（"5 个工具"这类数字最容易漏），改完让它们显式报红一次再放绿 —— 清单见 references/adding-a-tool-checklist.md。
- **`inject` 是硬闸，诊断量走可选访问。** `inject` 里列的服务缺席 ⇒ 插件**不加载**（cordis 的 required inject 无超时）⇒ 为了让一个**可选的诊断量**可用而把它加进 `inject`，等于把整个插件绑死在那个部署上。例：为了读"会话面"的 `contentGeneration` 而注入 `sessions`，会让没有该服务的部署**整个插件不加载**。正解＝装配点用 `ctx.get('<service>')?.<member>?.…` **逐层可选**，任一层缺席即 `undefined`，并在消费侧把它当 `unknown`（fail-open）。平台自己的 `ctx.attachments?.imageLimits` 就是这个形态。
- **公开面只有计数器时，就用计数器当"变了没有"的信号。** `SessionSurface` 只导出 `{nodes, replaceGeneration, contentGeneration}` —— **`projectedMessages` 不在公开面上** ⇒ 想查"某个块是不是已被投影替换"（如 `image/offload` 的占位符）就得自己去读会话日志并折叠，那是与平台重复的第二套机制。替代：平台的每次 `project` 都会让 `contentGeneration` 前进（`replace` 也前进，`append` 不前进）⇒ 把它当作**"面变没变"的粗粒度信号**：不同即重做，相同就用缓存结论。**代价是它会被无关变更推动**（偏保守、可能多做一次），但只要"重做"永远安全，这就是对的方向。

### 收窄参数的作用域比你想象的大：`allow` 是**整张面**的白名单（实测踩过，已发布缺陷）

- 症状：一个"只收窄自己命名空间"的选择器，发 `tools.restrict({ allow: [自己的名字…] })` ⇒ **调用者当场丢掉 preset 给的其它工具**（read／write／bash／MCP 全部变 `unknown tool`）。
- 机制：`allow` 的语义是 **keep only**，作用在**继承面（全局层＋祖先层）整张表**上，不是"与你给的名字取交集"；`deny` 才是外科式的（只摘点名的）。平台文档原话见 `Restrict **global** tools … allow (keep only)`；凭名字猜语义会猜反。
- **最快的判据是平台自带的测试**（不是注释）：`packages/core/tools/tests/scoped.spec.ts` 里正面断言 `restrict({ allow: ['read'] })` ⇒ `bash` 变 `Error: unknown tool "bash"`，而作用域内自注册的 `capture` **仍在**。凡"过滤参数"先找平台自己的测试，看它断言了什么被去掉。
- 修法与守门断言：改发 `deny`＝**自己命名空间内的补集**；再把 deny 与平台真值（`tools.schemas(agent)` 的当前名字）取交，避免未注册名让 `restrict` 抛 unknown。测试替身要**放一个别人的工具进去**，并断言"别人的工具一个都不许进 deny"——否则替身太干净，这类整面误伤永远不会红。

### 工具可见性的两半：注册可按 agent，收窄只认全局（0.2.0-rc.2 实测）

- `tools.register(definition)` 的文档原话：*Register globally or in the calling agent scope. Scoped tools shadow globals; duplicates within one layer and the reserved run_code name fail.* ⇒ **运行期造出来的工具可以按 agent 注册**（同名遮蔽全局），并返回精确的 disposer。
- `tools.restrict(filter)` 的文档原话：*Restrict **global** tools for the calling agent scope. … scope-local names … fail. Restrictions intersect; **scoped registrations remain visible**.* ⇒ **收窄是一张全局工具掩码，够不到 agent 作用域里的注册**。
- ⇒ 由此推出一条设计级取舍：要让模型"造工具"，注册层只能二选一 —— **全局注册**（可被收窄治理，但对所有 agent 可见）或 **按 agent 注册**（隔离正确，但模型的"多选"管不到它）。平台不提供第三条路；把这一点写进方案，别指望后面补一个开关。
- `run_code` 在两处都是保留名：注册不能用它（`tool name "run_code" is reserved …`）、收窄名单里也不许出现它。

## 把文案搬进字典 ≠ 改个名字：按"哪一层握着翻译器"分工（2026-08-13 实测）

- **症状**：为了"用户面文案必须来自字典"，直接把 `t('key')` 写进产生文案的那一层 —— 而那一层（控制器／状态机／纯逻辑）**根本没有 `t`**：它是模块作用域函数，翻译器只在组件渲染时才注入。结果是整块功能抛 `ReferenceError`，五条测试同时红。
- **机制**：翻译器是**渲染边界**才有的依赖（组件从 props／apply 作用域拿到 `t`），逻辑层拿不到也不该拿。
- **正确分工**：*模型层存**键**，边界层做**翻译***——`failed = { kind: 'transport', key: 'save.failedTransport' }`，渲染处 `t(failed.key)`。同理，kit 里的展示型函数要么**收 `t` 作为参数**（与"字段 spec 都带 `t`"的既有约定一致），要么由调用方在渲染时翻译；**不要让展示函数去闭包捕获一个它拿不到的 `t`**。
- **判据**：逻辑层的返回值里**不应出现面向用户的句子**（只有键、码、枚举）；渲染层**不应出现自然语言字面量**。两条都能机械检查：前者查"逻辑层字符串里有没有成句的中文/英文"，后者就是命名闸。

## Pluggable capabilities: declare as frozen data, bind the implementation separately (2026-10-13)

- **Split the declaration from the implementation.** The declaration is **serializable data** (`{id, api_version, summary, params, produces, effect, numeric}`), carries **no function reference**, and is returned **frozen**; the implementation is bound in a registry keyed by `id@api_version`. Why: only data can be printed, diffed, put in a return value or generate another artifact (an input schema, a description, a digest) — and "which implementation produced this reading" must be answerable from the value alone.
- **Validate strictly and loudly**: reject **unknown fields** (a declaration is a contract; every extra field is one more truth nobody checks), reject duplicate parameter names, require `enum` values to match the declared `type`, reject `min > max`, and keep enumerated vocabularies **closed** (a token outside the list is free text, not a declaration).
- **Registry guards worth copying** (they mirror what the host does for its own registries): refuse a declaration that **is not frozen** (otherwise a caller smuggles in an unvalidated object and the contract claim breaks), refuse a non-function implementation, and refuse a **duplicate key** (a duplicate means someone believes they changed the implementation when they did not). Keep enumeration order = registration order, so generated artifacts (enums, descriptions) do not jitter between runs.
- **Payoff**: with the contract layer in a directory that is *forbidden to import anything*, the whole layer becomes directly unit-testable with no doubles — contract errors go red before any consumer runs.

## A contractually import-free layer decides where shared data lives (2026-10-13)

- Symptom: a new `builtin.js` in the *pure* directory imported its sibling (`./spec.js`) for the validator ⇒ the repo's own absolute rule ("this directory imports nothing, ever") went red on the next check.
- Fix (and the only compliant shape): move the shared declarations **into the module that already owns the validator** and export them from there. Do not split "data" and "validation" across two files inside an import-free directory — the constraint is directory-wide, not per-file.
- Generalization: when a layer is declared import-free, every shared constant, default table or built-in declaration must live **inside one of that layer's own modules**; a new sibling file that imports anything is a violation by construction. Read the rule before choosing the file layout — the rule is stated in the checker, and it is cheaper to obey it than to argue with it.
- Second-order effect worth knowing: consumers in other layers (assembly, test doubles, tests that build their own dependency object) should all reference the **same exported object** rather than re-declaring it; duplicated declarations drift silently, and no test notices.

## A self-describing field whose reference does not exist yet must be deferred — on the record (2026-10-13)

- Situation: a return value is supposed to carry an implementation digest ("which build of this operator produced this reading"). For built-in operators the implementation is **spread across several modules**, so there is no single addressable source text to digest.
- The wrong move is to synthesize one anyway: a digest over *something adjacent* produces a precisely formatted value that cannot answer the question it exists for — worse than an absent field, because readers trust it.
- The right move: **defer the field, and write down where it becomes meaningful** (here: once operators exist as loaded source files, each with one addressable text). Record it as a deliberate deferral with its reason, in the same ledger as the delivered items — so a later reader can tell "not done yet, on purpose" apart from "forgotten".
- Companion: when the referent *does* exist, put the identity in the value **and** the key and assert their sameness in a test — two places deriving the same identity is exactly where silent divergence starts.

## Name a result field after what it is — a `code` slot becomes an error code downstream (2026-10-13)

- Symptom: a comparability verdict (`channel-mismatch`) was returned in a field named `code`. Semantically it is an **alignment value**, not an error: it means "these two cannot be compared", which the caller returns as `alignment`. But the repo's error-code gate scans every `code:` position and demanded the literal be registered in the error-code table — a false obligation created purely by the field name.
- Fix: rename the field to what it is (`alignment`). The gate noise disappears and the semantics stop lying; the caller composes `alignment: verdict.alignment`.
- Generalization: a field name is a **contract with the whole toolchain** — validators, tables, docs and gate rules key off names like `code`, `id`, `digest`, `version`. Putting a value in a slot whose name promises something else creates obligations (and false failures) far from the point of origin. Fix the name, not the checker.

## Split the shaping half from the calling half — and reuse vocabulary before coining it (2026-10-13)

- **Rule 1 (testability)**: a capability that both *shapes a declaration* and *calls the host* should be built as two pieces: a **pure** piece that produces the exact data the host will consume (tool name, description, parameter map, output schema/render), and a thin piece that performs the call and the post-call check. Reason: the shaping piece decides **what the model actually sees**, yet if it lives inside the calling function it can never be covered by fast unit tests — and it is where the interesting defects live (wrong wrapper shape, missing `render`, over-long name).
- **Rule 2 (vocabulary)**: before inventing a new identifier (error code, status literal, field name), search the existing vocabulary for one with the same meaning. Measured: a freshly coined `op_not_recomputable_scope` immediately triggered the repo's error-code ledger gate (every emitted code must be registered) *and* risked confusion with an existing **success-branch field** of similar name. Reusing the already-registered `no_session_scope` satisfied the gate, kept the vocabulary small, and read better. Coining an identifier is never free: it creates registration duties and collision risk at every downstream consumer.

## LLM 任务的载体选择：先问"证据筛选由谁做"（2026-10-16 实测）

给插件里的一段判断选载体时，真正的分岔**不是**"子智能体 vs 单次结构化调用"，而是**证据筛选归谁**：

- **单次结构化调用**擅长可比、可记录、可跨版本对照的判断，但它**不会自己找证据** —— 你得先把决定性那几段挑出来；
- **子智能体**擅长**导航**（自己决定读哪段、要不要翻 `references/`、逐条引 `path:line`），代价是 token/延迟不可预测、
  探索路径每次不同 ⇒ 同一输入在不同轮次可能给出不同判决，台账失去可比性。

实测（判一对技能是否该合并，44 个技能的库）：整篇正文中位 **26.6k tokens/对** → 头部抽取（description ＋ 引言段 ＋
"何时用" ＋ 边界）压到 **9%**（约 1k tokens/对）；头部与整篇的**排序相关性 0.668**，而**仅 description ≈ 0（-0.022）**。
⇒ 可用的形制是**三级级联 + 三选项 schema**（`1 需合并 / 0 信息不足 / -1 不需合并`）：L0 只喂名字+描述+各级分数
（早期退出；`1` 与 `0` 都上送，因为 L0 的 `1` 不足以定案）→ L1 喂头部抽取（**只有 `0` 上送**）→ L2 喂正文关键段或子智能体取证。
三级输出**同一 schema**，每条记 `level` 与 `trail` —— 否则无法区分"判决变化来自语料"还是"来自采样/探索路径"。
⇒ 周期性插件里的分配：**主力单次调用**（成本可预测、台账可比），**子智能体只做少数升级**（证据被截断、低置信、两向矛盾）。

- 每条「归谁」都指到 `文件:行` 或实测读数；不写「平台应该没有」这类无证据的否定。
- 每个实体在归属表里有唯一所有者，且**没有两个所有者**（重复即缺陷）。
- 扩展点的外延价值单独说过一次：**没有新扩展点时，这个插件本身还值不值？** 说得出才算立项。
- 有边界句：明确列出「不做什么」，并说明每条不做会给谁省下什么。

# DSH PTC brace prompt failure

A PTC-mode session (`tools:sdk` prompt section) fails the whole turn when any
visible tool description contains a `{{...}}` group whose body is not a valid
prompt variable name. This skill reproduces it in one headless run, finds every

  presets stay green.

## Prerequisites

## Pitfalls

- **中招要同时满足两个条件，少一个就是绿的**（2026-10-10 实测：同一份坏二进制、同一 PTC 模式，两个平台结论相反）：
  ① **平台版本对 `tools:sdk` 做插值**。0.1.5-rc.2 的 `renderPrompt` 是**无条件** `interpolate(section, …)`
  （`packages/core/system-prompt/src/index.ts:275`）；0.2.0-rc.2 是
  `section.interpolate === false ? section.text : interpolate(…)`（同文件 `:281`），且其 `sdkSection()`
  明确写了 `interpolate: false`（`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:900`）⇒ 该段整体不插值，`{{…}}` 原样输出。
  ② **该会话展示模式是 `ptc`/`both`**。`sdkSection()` 在 `mode === 'native'` 时返回空串，空段被丢弃
  （两版都有，`tools/src/index.ts:896-914` / 0.1.5 `:867-874`）⇒ native 会话的描述根本不进这个段。
  实测对照（officecli 未打补丁的构建 + `DSH_TOOLS_MODE=ptc` + 同一 overlay）：桌面 app 内置 CLI
  **0.2.0-rc.2** → `OK`；npm 全局 CLI **0.1.5-rc.2** → 原句报错。
  ⇒ **别拿新平台/ native preset 的绿去推断老平台/ PTC 会话没事**，反之亦然；报"某个 MCP 行把聊天搞挂了"
  之前先把 (平台版本, preset) 两项报清楚。同理：这个 bug 类在 0.2.x 升上去后会自动消失，但 0.1.5-rc.2 线上仍需要 fork 补丁。
- **重建 fork 二进制 = 必须重跑第 3 步。** 2026-10-10 实测事故：`fork\officecli.exe` 在 09:27 被重建成
  未打补丁的 v1.0.156（描述 4021 字符、`{{` 在 1281），但**当时两个宿主的 MCP 子进程仍跑着旧镜像**，
  所以现场是绿的；直到子进程被重拉（杀进程/重启宿主都算），两个平面（npm/web 与桌面）的 PTC 会话
  才从重拉后 3 秒起全线 `tools:sdk` 报错。**同一份 exe 被 desktop 与 web 两个 profile 共用**
  （`profiles/{desktop,web}/cordis.patch.yml` 都指向 `D:\claw\_tools\officecli\fork\officecli.exe`），
  换一次两个平面一起坏。回滚：把补丁版（当时是 `officecli.exe.old`，descLen 4023）盖回该路径，
  再杀掉两个 `officecli.exe mcp` 子进程让客户端自动重拉；坏构建留 `.unpatched-<stamp>.bak` 别删。
  修完必须同时过：第 3 步 `IndexOf('{{')` = -1 **且** PTC 复现格打印 `OK`。
- `interpolate()` has no escape syntax: `{{` must be broken (`{ {`) or reached
  through a variable, because substituted values are not rescanned.
- A leaked `{{` anywhere in a section body is enough; the tools registry scans
  the WHOLE rendered SDK block, not just the offending tool's doc line.
- Only PTC/`both` render `tools:sdk`; native sessions cannot hit this path.
- `validate`-style shape checks and `list()` broken flags say nothing about this;
  only a real assembly does.
- **部署路径可以被 DSH 之外的动作换掉，所以"谁改的"常常查不到** —— 2026-10-11 09:45:27 第三次复发：
  `fork\officecli.exe` 被写成与 `officecli.exe.unpatched-20261010.bak` **逐字节相同**的 v1.0.156
  （`{{`@1281 / descLen 4021），而当日 03:00–14:00 所有 workspace 分组下**没有任何会话落盘**、
  机器上也**没有 PSReadLine 历史文件** ⇒ 不是 agent 会话干的（写入口令：CreationTime 保持
  2026-09-22 17:20:12 而 mtime = 当日 ⇒ Copy-Item -Force 类就地覆盖；若 mtime 等于 .bak 自己的
  mtime 才是普通 Copy-Item）。宿主只在 MCP 子进程重拉时才吃到新镜像（本次 web 子进程 14:21:46、
  桌面 14:28:05 起来后立刻全线报错）⇒ **别把力气花在追责上：每次换完二进制就立刻跑门禁**。
- 已知哈希速判（2026-10-11 实测）：**坏** = 70B4E266…（officecli 1.0.156 未打补丁，descLen 4021，
  `{{`@1281，与 `.unpatched-20261010.bak` 同字节）｜**好** = **7EBB2298…（当前部署，1.0.156 + 补丁，
  descLen 4023，`{{` 计数 0，源码 699cafb + 5f2c262）**、9C8DB979…（`officecli.exe.old`，1.0.152 + 补丁，回滚源）。
- **换 exe 必须先「改名腾位」**（2026-10-11 实测）：在役 `officecli.exe mcp` 子进程锁着部署路径，直接
  `Copy-Item -Force` 报 IOException；而子进程被 kill 后**秒级自动重拉**，杀不干净 ⇒
  `Move-Item officecli.exe officecli.exe.swap-tmp` → 放入新件 → `Get-Process officecli | Stop-Process -Force`
  → 删 swap 副本。重建走「publish 到暂存目录 → 先对暂存件跑门禁 → 再改名腾位部署 → 部署后复跑门禁」。

# DSH Session Forensics

Trace one prompt or turn across the whole DSH chain — browser client, host session, agent loop —
and name the exact hop that dropped it, using on-disk session artifacts plus the client source.
It answers "which link is blocked" with evidence instead of UI impressions. It does NOT cover
release/version work (see `dsh-evolution-maintenance`) or plugin protocol breakage
(see `dsh-plugin-compatibility`), and it is strictly read-only against the running host.

## When to Use

- 「结果如何」/「怎么样了」/「跑完了吗」arrives after a host restart or context compaction, with no
  antecedent in this session — treat it as "the most recent open thread in THIS workspace", not as a
  question needing clarification (see the continuation subsection below).
- "网页端发了消息，模型没反应" / a message is visible in the GUI but never gets a reply.
- One client surface works while another does not (page composer vs Chrome side panel vs side chat).
- A turn looks stuck, a session looks wedged, or an app restart is suspected as the trigger.
- You need to prove whether the host ever received a given text.
- A session ZIP appears (`dsh-session-<id>.zip`) and the question is "can this be imported into the
  other client / another machine?" — the platform is export-only; see the transfer section below.

## Prerequisites

- DSH install root (Windows): `%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh`; nested deps live in
  its `node_modules\@deepseek-ai` folder — that is where client/server packages and their sources are.
- **Know which host you are on, and WHERE ITS HOME IS.** Port 19387 belongs to the DESKTOP app's host process
  (`DeepSeek Harness.exe`, and your own tool calls run as its child processes); the npm-global
  `dsh web` instance listens on 3080.
  **★ The two hosts no longer necessarily share `~/.dsh`** (measured 2026-10-13): the web plane's launcher
  `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\start-dsh-web.cmd` sets `DSH_HOME=D:\dsh-homes\web` (+ `DSH_AGENTS_HOME`), so
  **sessions / storages / skills / memories are separate per plane and invisible to each other** —
  look for a session or a storage file under `~/.dsh` and you will find nothing, with no error.
  ⇒ **Read `DSH_HOME` from the launcher before searching**, and when a store file is reported missing,
  check the OTHER home's `sessions/` and `storages/` before concluding it does not exist. The desktop
  plane's launcher is the same `~/.dsh` unless its own script overrides it — verify, do not assume.
- The active profile: `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>` — `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` is the real
  plugin roster; `cordis.patch.yml` holds per-row user overrides (last layer wins).
- **The same-version source tree outranks any shipped bundle.** Each release has a full checkout in the
  workspace (`D:\dsh\dsh-upstream-<version>` — `packages/`, `docs/`, `.git`). Resolve which version is
  actually RUNNING first (web: `<global npm root>/@deepseek-ai/dsh/package.json`; desktop: the
  `app: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop <ver>` line in
  `%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-web-boot.log`), then answer platform-capability
  questions from that tree and cite `file:line`. The user asks for exactly this before accepting an
  answer; it is where "does this feature even exist" gets settled.
- Node >= 22 — **never decode the log with `zlib.zstdDecompressSync` / `createZstdDecompress`**: the file is a CONCATENATION of one zstd frame per flush (measured 2026-09-29: 572,545 frames across 338 logs), the sync API silently returns only the FIRST frame (170–257 B out of a 129 MB file, and it looks like it succeeded), and the stream form returned 0 B. Split at the frame magic `28 b5 2f fd` and decode each slice, or just run `scripts/dsh-session-probe.cjs` (it already frame-splits: `frames=35440 events=80972` on a live log). Reading CJK through the PowerShell console mangles it (U+00B7 printed as 「路」) — compare code points in node. — run `node --version` first.
- Optional: the browser bridge for UI-side classification (`browser_snapshot`, `browser_get_text`).

## How to Run

Locate the session directory, read the plaintext projection for cheap authoritative state,
decompress the event log for the timeline, then read the client source for whichever surface
submitted. Decide every verdict on host artifacts; use the UI only to classify an artifact.

## Quick Reference

Windows artifact map (`~` = `%USERPROFILE%`):

- `<DSH_HOME>\sessions\<escaped-cwd>\session-<uuid>\session.vN.jsonl.zstd` — the event log.
  **`vN` is versioned and moves with the release** (`session.v3.*` = 0.1.5-rc.2, `session.v4.*` =
  0.2.0-rc.2 — measured 2026-10-13 on the web plane). **Glob `session.v*.jsonl.zstd`, never the
  literal v3 name**: a `-Filter 'session.jsonl.zstd'` (or any exact-version guess) returns 0 files
  while 217 sit there, which reads as "no sessions". `DSH_HOME` may not be `~/.dsh` — see Prerequisites.
  The cwd is escaped into the folder name: `C:\Users\x\.dsh\browser-sessions` becomes
  `--C-Users-x-.dsh-browser-sessions--`.
- `~\.dsh\storages\session_projcache\sessions\session-<uuid>.json` — plaintext projection of the
  same session, rewritten on every change; `rows.*.seq` gives ordering. Cheapest source of truth.
- `~\.dsh\settings.yaml` — host settings (model, presets, permission default, per-plugin blocks).
- `scripts/dsh-session-probe.cjs` — frame-splits the zstd log and prints a turn/inbox timeline;
  also summarises a projection file (`inbox` + `turnOutline`).
- `scripts/dsh-renderer-probe.mjs` — reads the DESKTOP renderer over CDP (port 9222, target
  `dsh-app://app/`): `rows` / `expand` dump the sidebar with workspace groups, row keys and indent,
  `eval <file.js>` runs JS in the page, `reload` re-pulls the client list. This is the authority for
  what the user actually sees.

Event types that matter: `user/message`, `agent/inbox/spliced`, `turn/start`, `turn/end`,
`assistant/message`, `system/message`. For "why did this turn fail", two more carry the payload:
**`turn/end`** → `data.reason.{kind,error:{message,code}}`, the ONLY durable record of a failed turn
(the 「本轮运行失败」 banner is that `message` verbatim, per `client/ui-chat/src/client/locale.ts:168`),
and **`tool/call`** → `data.{turn,step,callId,name,arguments}` — committed calls only, because a turn
that dies mid-stream commits neither an assistant message nor a tool call and its arguments are then
lost forever. There is no top-level `chunk` record type. Census plus committed-argument validation:
`scripts/dsh-turn-failure-census.mjs <DSH_HOME> …` (point it at both homes); measured readings, the
`llm-deepseek` provider-error taxonomy and the two counting traps: `references/turn-failure-census.md`.

The single most decisive field is the projection's inbox row:

```json
"inbox": { "ver": 1, "seq": 321, "val": { "next-turn": [], "next-step": [] } }
```

A prompt that reached the host appears as `agent/inbox/spliced` with
`{"target":"next-turn","inserted":[<the message>]}` immediately followed by `turn/start`, then a
second splice with `{"removedCount":1,"inserted":[]}` as it is consumed. Inbox empty + no splice at
that timestamp ⇒ the message never left the client.

Client source for the composer surface:
`<dsh root>\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-conversation\lib\client.js`

- `resolveSubmitMode(preferred, running, gesture, steeringAvailable)` — `if (!running || !steeringAvailable) return "queue"`;
  plain Enter and the Send button share the `enter` gesture, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter uses the opposite behavior.
- `BUSY_ENTER_FIELD = "busyEnter"`, `DEFAULT_BUSY_ENTER_BEHAVIOR = "queue"` — user-visible as
  「繁忙时的发送行为」/ "Send behavior while busy".
- `sink()` — documented as "optimistic clear + prompt": the composer is cleared BEFORE the send
  settles, and on failure the draft is restored only while untouched. This is why a dropped submit
  looks like "input empty, no reply, no error".
- `steerQueue()` / QueueDock — per-row Steer, and Ctrl+Enter steers all still-queued rows.

## Procedure

1. Enumerate the client surfaces before touching anything: the page composer, the Chrome side panel
   (a SECOND DSH client with its own connection — it bundles `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection`),
   and any in-page side-chat plugin. Read `dsh.profile.bundles` for the roster. A side chat that
   "does not enter the main session" can never be the surface whose text shows up in the transcript.
2. Read the projection first (`read` tool): `rows.inbox.val`, `rows.turnOutline.val.turns`,
   `rows.titleInput.val.count`. Two turns recorded while the user believes he sent three messages is
   already a verdict.
3. Decompress the log with `scripts/dsh-session-probe.cjs` — never a single-shot zstd call.
4. Read the timeline as turns: `turn/start` → `user/message` → `assistant/message` → `turn/end`, with
   `agent/inbox/spliced` bracketing the enqueue and the consume.
5. Cross-check FIFO: if the user says message A preceded B, B's splice `inserted` array must contain
   A first. A one-item array is proof A never entered the host queue.
6. Only now look at the page, and only to classify: the composer is a `contenteditable` /
   `role="textbox"` element (not a `textarea`). If it is EMPTY while a message row renders just above
   it, that row is a client-local queued/optimistic artifact, not an unsent draft.
7. Read `sink()` / `resolveSubmitMode()` for the submitting surface to explain why the failure was
   silent, then state the broken hop. Do not prescribe a page reload as the fix — this class has
   survived a full reload in practice, so verify before recommending one.
8. Run the two-client control test: send the same prompt from a SECOND client surface (extension side
   panel, another window) and watch the host. A prompt that lands from client B while client A yields
   zero host effects (no `agent/inbox/spliced`, no inbox row, no new entity) localises the break to
   client A's command path and proves host, session, agent loop and model healthy.
9. Answer "restart or reload?" with this rule. A reload rebuilds the client and its connections, so a
   defect that survives it rules out client memory AND one-shot per-connection host state. What is left
   splits cleanly: a host-global wedged singleton (restart helps) vs a composition defect or
   browser-persisted state (restart does not). Discriminate with a client identity the host has never
   seen — incognito window, second browser, or cleared site data: works there => do not restart the
   host; fails there too => restart, and if it returns at once, bisect the profile's plugin rows in
   `cordis.patch.yml`, which the watcher hot-mounts so no further restart is needed.

## Session export, import, and store transfer

Export exists; **import does not**. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export` produces
`dsh-session-<id>.zip` (`session.vN.jsonl` + `media/<attachmentId>.<ext>` + `files/…`) through `/export`
or the header's 「下载 Session 日志」, and no route, command, or package takes one back. Answer this
class in order:

1. **Same DSH_HOME ⇒ same store ⇒ nothing to import.** Every profile's base bundle sets
   `root: !!js dshHomePath('sessions')`, so on one machine web and desktop list the same
   `~/.dsh/sessions/--<projectKey(cwd)>--/<encodeSegment(id)>/`. Compare the archive entry against the
   store log byte-for-byte before proposing a transfer — the 2026-10-10 case was a ZIP of a session
   already in the desktop's store, so the honest answer was "no-op, it is already listed".
2. **Direction matters across versions.** Read `SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION` in both source trees. A newer
   reader migrates an older generation (read-only open: in memory, publishes nothing; write-open:
   publishes the successor generation, source byte-identical); the reverse direction is not guaranteed.
3. **One writer at a time.** Write ownership is a cross-process kernel lock beside the log
   (`session.lock`: `flock` on POSIX, a named semaphore on Windows), the loser gets
   `SessionAlreadyOwnedError`, and there is no expiry — the client holding the session must release it
   before another resumes it.
4. **A store root accepts exactly ONE physical encoding.** Appending the ZIP's raw `session.vN.jsonl`
   to a `.jsonl.zstd` root fails loud on list/create/open: `session artifact "…" uses .jsonl, but this
   backend is configured for compression "zstd"`; a log sitting directly in the project dir is the
   rejected legacy flat layout. Re-encode to the root's encoding instead of copying.
5. **Attachments are content-addressed outside the session dir** (images `attachments/v1/objects/<2>/<sha>`,
   files `files/…` + `file-objects/…`), and their `sha256:`-named archive entries break Windows' own
   extractor (`不支持给定路径的格式`) — extract programmatically or with 7z.

Exact rules, error strings, the writer-version matrix and the verification recipe:
`references/session-export-and-store-transfer.md`; re-runnable tooling:
`scripts/dsh-session-zip.mjs` (`list` / `extract` / `compare` / `plan` / `restore` — `restore` refuses
an existing target and a root-encoding mismatch, and the derived path was verified against the live
store's own bucket name).

## Out-of-band sessions and the desktop sidebar

A session written by another process — the other host, an import, a hand-placed file — can be
perfectly readable and still absent from the sidebar, both in its workspace group and in 未分组.
The sidebar shows, per workspace, the **durable member list** in
`~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` → `tables.workspaces[<id>].sessionIds`, filtered to ids whose cwd
resolves to that workspace path (`packages/workspace/workspace/src/entity.ts:101-103`); everything else
trails in 未分组, and a group renders only a slice plus 「展开其余 N 个会话」. Membership changes only by
`attachSession` (`entity.ts:109+`, called when a host creates or forks a session) or by `bootstrap`,
which merges store sessions by cwd **exclusively while the storage is uninitialized**
(`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts:206-212`; every real store carries `global.initialized:
true`) — so **a restart never re-groups anything**. Lineage renders a fork *indented under its parent*.
Two refreshes fix two different halves:

- **renderer reload** (Ctrl+R, or `scripts/dsh-renderer-probe.mjs reload`) → the client re-pulls the
  list and the row appears (ungrouped, titled 未命名); host, runs and sessions untouched.
- **host restart** → the member list is re-read from `workspace.json` and title projections are
  recomputed (that is what turns an ungrouped 未命名 row into its real title), but membership itself is
  *not* recalculated. Your own tool calls are children of the host process, so a restart issued from
  inside a turn kills that turn — hand it to the user, then verify with the probe.

`session_event_read` proves the host can read such a session (and resolves its real title) but never
attaches it, and a read-only SQLite probe of the live index can report a stale snapshot — never read
absence out of it. Mechanism, code citations and measured before/after sidebar rows:
`references/host-registration-and-ui-visibility.md`.

**The mirror symptom is not damage.** The member list is durable and *shared by both hosts*: whichever
host attaches a session (its own create/fork, or the other client's) writes the id, so a group can show
the other client's conversations (`session.v3.*` = 0.1.5-rc.2 / npm global vs `session.v4.*` =
0.2.0-rc.2 / desktop tells them apart) while rows that were in the group only because the previous host
run held them live fall down to 未分组. The user reads that as "我导入一条对话，结果 npm 侧的对话把我的
全顶掉了". Answer from the store, never from the list: neither a reload nor a restart writes session
files, so `--<projectKey(cwd)>--` still holds every id that was listed before — verify id by id, say
plainly that nothing was overwritten, and name the durable-membership cause. Repair, in order:
(1) opening the row in the client does NOT attach it — measured 2026-10-10: member table mtime and
member count unchanged after the click, and `attachSession` is only called on create/fork — so go
straight to (2); (2) with no desktop host listening, run
`node scripts/dsh-workspace-membership.mjs restore --workspace <cwd> --only <id,id> --apply` and
restart — `--only` is what keeps old test sessions and subagent children in 未分组, and a running host
re-persists its own membership over the edit. `report` mode prints each workspace's members plus
the store ids missing from it, which is also how to prove "which conversations the group lost".

## Answering "结果如何" after a restart (state forensics, not path forensics)

A restarted host keeps the files but loses your in-session memory; the user does not know that and asks
the bare question anyway. Rebuild the answer from disk, then finish from live state — never from memory
of the previous turn, and never by re-asking which task he means (he expects the last open thread in
this workspace, which his question presupposes).

1. **Open the handoff card, not the transcript.** `<workspace>\*situation-*.md`, then the newest
   `*续接卡*.md` / `*continuation*.md` under the active audit directory. They carry status, the exact
   remaining steps, and the deciding numbers; read the newest first because they supersede each other.
2. **Shared state beats recollection for run-style work.** `~/.dsh/evolution/runs.json` (state, pid,
   startedAt/endedAt, resultRef) plus `reports/<kind>-<id>.{md,json}` — a `succeeded` row with a
   `resultRef` IS the result. Cross-session probe rows (`cancelled`, "probe" wording) in the same file
   are normal noise from other writers, not failures of the current thread.
3. **Measure three live facts before saying "done".** (a) which process owns the relevant port and when
   it started — one command answers "is the host up, and on which bytes?"; (b) the installed version
   (`profiles/<name>/package.json`, the lockfile, and `node_modules/@lmzhen/*` package.json versions)
   against the published tag; (c) `git log/tag` of the release repo, so "published" is a tag, not a claim.
4. **Answer with the reading next to each claim**, name what is still open (cleanups, undecided items),
   and close by offering the plausible alternative reading if the instruction could have meant another
   recently touched thread — one clause, not a question that stalls the answer.
5. A card is a save file: when a long run is interrupted mid-flight, write the card BEFORE doing anything
   else, and keep every number in it reproducible by a command printed in the same file.

## Pitfalls

- `Get-Process node` is not a liveness test: it returns nothing (or `Get-CimInstance` returns 拒绝访问)
  under the sandbox while the host is up. Use `netstat -ano | Select-String ':19387\s'` for the listener
  and its owning pid. Reading the version off disk and the pid off the port is what turns "seems done"
  into a verified state.
- An MSYS/Win32 UNC-style `glob` outside the session workspace may time out or come back `os error 3`;
  enumerate with `pwsh` when the tree is large, or glob inside the workspace only.

- `zstdDecompressSync` and `createZstdDecompress` stop at the FIRST frame; the log is multi-frame and
  a naive call yields ~200 chars of header. Frame-split on the magic bytes `28 B5 2F FD`.
- A plain HTTP fetch of the GUI (`http://127.0.0.1:3080/`) returns 401 — the host requires auth. Read
  the page through the browser bridge instead of `Invoke-WebRequest`.
- The Windows console mangles UTF-8 Chinese (`Get-Content -Raw` prints mojibake) — **that was Windows PowerShell 5.1; the DSH `pwsh` tool is 7.6.7 since 2026-10-15 and prints CJK intact (measured)**. It still bites an explicit `powershell.exe`. Use the `read` tool,
  or `Select-String` for matching, when a file contains non-ASCII.
- Never infer authorship from UI text. Grep the installed plugins with `grep` for the literal string
  first: if no plugin ships it, it is user-originated (a pet/remark plugin can otherwise masquerade as
  a stuck message). Coincidental substring hits inside minified bundles (`emmet`, domain tables) are
  noise — always read the surrounding context, and remember the bundles are minified and nested.
- `browser_snapshot`'s quoted label for a textbox may be the placeholder, present even when the field
  has content. Confirm emptiness separately with `browser_get_text({selector: '[contenteditable]'})`.
- Do not generalise one wedge into "surface X is broken". A hung submit can be transient; ask the user
  to re-send from the suspect surface and re-check the inbox before prescribing a fix.
- Confirmed signature of the HOST-MEMORY variant (observed live): every command from ONE client yields
  zero host effects while a second client's prompts land normally, and a full page reload reproduces the
  failure exactly. A reload creates a new client connection but does not clean the host's stale
  registration; only restarting the host process cleared it. So skip the reload, capture evidence with
  `scripts/dsh-web-wedge-snapshot.cjs`, then restart the host and confirm with a fresh splice event.
- Verify a suspected host restart from the PROCESS, never from file or directory mtimes: a session
  directory's mtime does not change when the log inside it is rewritten. Compare the `dsh web` PID,
  its start time, and the owner of the listening port — one command answers "did it restart?".
- Never count occurrences of a UI string across the whole page text: the transcript quotes the very
  strings you are hunting, so the counts are contaminated. Read the owning container instead (the DSH
  composer card carries `data-composer-card`) or use the numbered element inventory. **The session log
  has the same disease, worse** — it holds every message and tool result of the very session you are
  reading, so a substring scan for an error string mostly matches your own prose (measured 2026-10-13:
  50 raw "hits" for one string, 6 real). Split lines, `JSON.parse`, branch on `rec.type`/`rec.data`.
- **Two more census traps in that family.** A session is stored once per format version
  (`session.v3` for 0.1.5-rc.2 beside `session.v4` for 0.2.0-rc.2), so every `turn/end` is counted
  2-3x — dedupe on session+turn+time+code (measured: 123 raw → 50 real). And `{"type":"chunk", time, chunk}` lines **are** a real
  record shape — that is `AssistantStreamRecord` inside `assistant/attempt.data.stream`
  (`packages/core/session/src/types.ts:355`), the durable per-attempt stream. Correction to an earlier

## Abort attribution (a turn that ends by itself)

A user-visible `This operation was aborted` is an `AbortError` from a **plain `abort()`**; a timeout
signal reads `The operation was aborted due to timeout` instead. Read the pair, not the prose:

- Child session's last event `turn/end {reason:{kind:'aborted',reason:{kind:'parent'}}}` ⇒ the PARENT
  cancelled it. If that child log then shows no model error and no tool timeout, stop blaming the
  child — and do not blame the LLM stream-idle watchdog unless `MESSAGES_IDLE` / `stream idle timeout`
  is actually present (it only counts one outstanding read, and SSE events/heartbeat comments pulse it).
- The parent's `command/run` → `command/done {kind:'error'}` timestamps give the wall clock. A round
  number (300 s, 600 s) with 1–2 s of spread across attempts is a FIXED DEADLINE, not a stall; a stall
  scatters.
- `CommandInvocation.signal` is documented as "owned by the dispatching UI request"
  (`packages/interaction/commands/src/index.ts:56`), so an abort at a round wall-clock number points at
  the REQUEST's lifetime (client/transport) rather than at any model or tool timer.

When a constant grep comes up empty, trace the CALL PATH instead of widening the search: start from the platform
interfaces the plugin actually uses and read each hop's implementation to the end — for a slash command that is
`commands.execute(...)` (`@Remote`, `interaction/commands/src/index.ts:360`, signal "owned by the dispatching UI
request") → the client caller (`client/ui-commands/src/client/service.ts` → `client/connection/src/client/rpc.ts`
HTTP POST, signal only when the caller supplies one) → the host carrier (`client/connection/src/http-bridge.ts:47-49`,
where a premature socket close becomes a PLAIN `abort()` — the exact source of the user-visible text) → the HTTP server
(`host/webserver/src/index.ts:243`, no timeout overrides). Say where the trace bottoms out when the owner sits below the
repository (Electron/Chromium socket behaviour) instead of inventing a mechanism — and disprove a promising suspect with a
scaled-down experiment rather than argument (see the reference: Node's `requestTimeout` looked exact, then survived).
Enumerate before blaming: non-test constants of the same-version source tree in the observed band, the
running profile's row configs (`cordis.patch.yml`, the bundle patches), and the running build's own
bundles — a mechanism that merely sounds plausible must also match the log's signature. Worked example
with the exact log lines and what it ruled out: `references/abort-attribution.md`.

## Session export, import, and store transfer

Export exists; **import does not**. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export` produces
`dsh-session-<id>.zip` (`session.vN.jsonl` + `media/<attachmentId>.<ext>` + `files/…`) through `/export`
or the header's 「下载 Session 日志」, and no route, command, or package takes one back. Answer this
class in order:

1. **Same DSH_HOME ⇒ same store ⇒ nothing to import.** Every profile's base bundle sets
   `root: !!js dshHomePath('sessions')`, so on one machine web and desktop list the same
   `~/.dsh/sessions/--<projectKey(cwd)>--/<encodeSegment(id)>/`. Compare the archive entry against the
   store log byte-for-byte before proposing a transfer — the 2026-10-10 case was a ZIP of a session
   already in the desktop's store, so the honest answer was "no-op, it is already listed".
2. **Direction matters across versions.** Read `SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION` in both source trees. A newer
   reader migrates an older generation (read-only open: in memory, publishes nothing; write-open:
   publishes the successor generation, source byte-identical); the reverse direction is not guaranteed.
3. **One writer at a time.** Write ownership is a cross-process kernel lock beside the log
   (`session.lock`: `flock` on POSIX, a named semaphore on Windows), the loser gets
   `SessionAlreadyOwnedError`, and there is no expiry — the client holding the session must release it
   before another resumes it.
4. **A store root accepts exactly ONE physical encoding.** Appending the ZIP's raw `session.vN.jsonl`
   to a `.jsonl.zstd` root fails loud on list/create/open: `session artifact "…" uses .jsonl, but this
   backend is configured for compression "zstd"`; a log sitting directly in the project dir is the
   rejected legacy flat layout. Re-encode to the root's encoding instead of copying.
5. **Attachments are content-addressed outside the session dir** (images `attachments/v1/objects/<2>/<sha>`,
   files `files/…` + `file-objects/…`), and their `sha256:`-named archive entries break Windows' own
   extractor (`不支持给定路径的格式`) — extract programmatically or with 7z.

Exact rules, error strings, the writer-version matrix and the verification recipe:
`references/session-export-and-store-transfer.md`; re-runnable tooling:
`scripts/dsh-session-zip.mjs` (`list` / `extract` / `compare` / `plan` / `restore` — `restore` refuses
an existing target and a root-encoding mismatch, and the derived path was verified against the live

## Out-of-band sessions and the desktop sidebar

A session written by another process — the other host, an import, a hand-placed file — can be
perfectly readable and still absent from the sidebar, both in its workspace group and in 未分组.
The sidebar shows, per workspace, the **durable member list** in
`~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` → `tables.workspaces[<id>].sessionIds`, filtered to ids whose cwd
resolves to that workspace path (`packages/workspace/workspace/src/entity.ts:101-103`); everything else
trails in 未分组, and a group renders only a slice plus 「展开其余 N 个会话」. Membership changes only by
`attachSession` (`entity.ts:109+`, called when a host creates or forks a session) or by `bootstrap`,
which merges store sessions by cwd **exclusively while the storage is uninitialized**
(`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts:206-212`; every real store carries `global.initialized:
true`) — so **a restart never re-groups anything**. Lineage renders a fork *indented under its parent*.
Two refreshes fix two different halves:

- **renderer reload** (Ctrl+R, or `scripts/dsh-renderer-probe.mjs reload`) → the client re-pulls the
  list and the row appears (ungrouped, titled 未命名); host, runs and sessions untouched.
- **host restart** → the member list is re-read from `workspace.json` and title projections are
  recomputed (that is what turns an ungrouped 未命名 row into its real title), but membership itself is
  *not* recalculated. Your own tool calls are children of the host process, so a restart issued from
  inside a turn kills that turn — hand it to the user, then verify with the probe.

`session_event_read` proves the host can read such a session (and resolves its real title) but never
attaches it, and a read-only SQLite probe of the live index can report a stale snapshot — never read
absence out of it. Mechanism, code citations and measured before/after sidebar rows:
`references/host-registration-and-ui-visibility.md`.

**The mirror symptom is not damage.** The member list is durable and *shared by both hosts*: whichever
host attaches a session (its own create/fork, or the other client's) writes the id, so a group can show
the other client's conversations (`session.v3.*` = 0.1.5-rc.2 / npm global vs `session.v4.*` =
0.2.0-rc.2 / desktop tells them apart) while rows that were in the group only because the previous host
run held them live fall down to 未分组. The user reads that as "我导入一条对话，结果 npm 侧的对话把我的
全顶掉了". Answer from the store, never from the list: neither a reload nor a restart writes session
files, so `--<projectKey(cwd)>--` still holds every id that was listed before — verify id by id, say
plainly that nothing was overwritten, and name the durable-membership cause. Repair, in order:
(1) opening the row in the client does NOT attach it — measured 2026-10-10: member table mtime and
member count unchanged after the click, and `attachSession` is only called on create/fork — so go
